name: ak-render
description: Turn plans, reports, recaps, diff reviews, dashboards and explainers into one polished, offline, self-contained HTML page from a short YAML Page Spec, without hand-writing HTML.

interface.shortDescription: HTML pages from a YAML spec
interface.longDescription: Write a short YAML Page Spec and compile it into one deterministic, self-contained HTML page that opens offline. Use it to present plans, reports, recaps, diff reviews, dashboards, explainers and comparisons without hand-writing HTML, CSS or JavaScript. Runs locally through npx; requires Node.js 20.11 or later.
defaultPrompt: Render this plan as an HTML page with AK Render.
Turn the diff review into a polished offline report page.
Make a dashboard page from these metrics.
